name: Paperless-ngx
description: Paperless-ngx is a document management system that turns scanned paperwork into a searchable archive. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Paperless-ngx as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Document scanning and archiving system. Deploy Paperless-ngx with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
